6.characters: The staff's contact directory, behind the app's existing first Contact pill. The nav shape is the Campaign set's: a sub-tab strip of Overview | Contacts | Reports under the page title, with the existing /manage grid as the third tab rather than the whole page. Every control is taken from the running folk_hkmc app — the same header, the same tab strip, the same scope switch, the same grid toolbar and table, the same tokens. Where this set and _bmad-output/specs/spec-contacts-overview-reports/ disagree, the spec wins: it is the behavioural contract, and its opening table lists the seven corrections this drawing set carries.
